It has a Carhartt Force sweatband with FastDry technology and a Carhartt patch applique on the front. One size fits all.

specs.operating_system: Android TV with built-in Google Assistant
specs.design: Compact; available in white/silver or black/copper

record.description: The Epson EF-100 is a compact laser projector in black that projects images up to 150 inches. It runs Android TV with a remote that supports voice search through Google Assistant, and includes an internal speaker plus a 3.5mm stereo output. Its laser-based design is built to deliver bright, clear images.

specs.accent: Contrasting Swoosh from heel to midfoot

record.description: A retro-inspired tennis-style sneaker for women in black and white. The leather upper is paired with traditional laces and a soft fabric lining. The solid rubber outsole has a herringbone pattern for traction, and the midsole and outsole are fused during autoclave construction. A contrasting Swoosh runs from heel to midfoot. Women's size 8.5 Regular US.

specs.structure: Double layers with elastic loops and mesh pockets
specs.features: Detachable hand strap

record.description: A black, water-resistant nylon travel organizer with two zippers and a detachable hand strap. It has two layers with elastic loops for cables, mesh pockets for USB drives and chargers, an SD/TF card slot, and a pocket sized for a tablet up to 7.9 inches. Measures about 9.8 x 6.5 x 6.5 inches and weighs 173 grams.

specs.compartment: Large main compartment with wordmark zipper pull

record.description: Under Armour women's tote in Hushed Turquoise with a UA Storm finish described as highly water-resistant. It has a large main compartment with a wordmark zipper pull and double webbing straps for carrying options. When full it measures 20.3" W x 12.6" L x 9.8" H, with a capacity of about 25 liters.

The Nike Air Zoom Mariah Flyknit Racer is a shoe with a Flyknit upper and sock-like construction. It features Zoom Air cushioning, a heel pull tab, and a rubber outsole. This model, SKU 918264-200, is listed in size 10.5. The color is not specified in the listing.

specs.package_contents: Magnetic screen, hook&loop roll, push pins, instruction manual

record.description: A magnetic screen door curtain from Yotache made of heavy-duty 18 x 16 fiberglass mesh. It measures 38 by 81 inches and suits doors up to 36 by 80 inches. Webbing edges, reinforced stitching, and a hook-and-loop hasp help it stay secure, and the package includes installation supplies.

specs.material: Shag pile with high-density sponge middle layer
specs.features: Sound absorbing, shedding resistant

record.description: A 5x8 foot teal blue shag area rug with a 1.57-inch plush pile and a dense sponge layer for softness and sound absorption. Small anti-slip dots on the underside help it stay put on hard floors, though the underside should stay dry. Suited to living rooms, bedrooms, and kids' rooms.

specs.sleeve: Long sleeve with roll tab and buttons
specs.fit: Regular fit, straight cut at waist
specs.care: Machine or hand wash cold, do not bleach

record.description: A long-sleeve henley-style popover in blue, made from an 80% cotton and 20% polyester oxford blend. It has a mandarin collar, button placket at the chest, roll-tab sleeves with buttons, and a straight cut at the waist in a regular fit. Machine or hand wash in cold water without bleach. Sold in size 3XL.

specs.putting surface: approx. 2 ft x 8.5 ft inside border

record.description: A 3-by-10-foot putting training mat from JEF World of Golf, featuring a turf surface meant to resemble a real putting green. The mat has an inner putting area of roughly 2 by 8.5 feet, two holes with flags, and a padded rubber base. It is designed for use indoors or outdoors.

specs.compatible_bodies: Canon M1, M2, M3, M5, M6, M10

record.description: A manual-focus prime lens for Canon EOS-M mirrorless cameras, with a 35mm focal length (about 53mm equivalent on APS-C) and a maximum aperture of F1.2. It has a crescent-shaped focus ring and a six-element, five-group optical design in a black copper-core aluminum barrel. Listed compatible bodies include the M1, M2, M3, M5, M6, and M10.

Two ivory flameless candles, each 6 inches tall, with a frosted plastic shell and a moving flame effect. Battery powered, they come with a remote for on/off, brightness, flicker or steady glow, and 2, 4, 6, or 8 hour timers. Listed as waterproof for outdoor use.

specs.components: Long sleeve shirt or long johns, available separately

record.description: STARK SOUL men's functional thermal underwear set in black and blue, sizes L/XL. Sold as a long sleeve shirt or long johns, either separately. Made from high-elastic sports fabric with double-seamless construction and three-dimensional elastic zones. Designed for autumn-winter use in activities such as hiking, skiing, cycling, and training.

specs.compatible_with: Mini S530 Bluetooth earbuds, earphones, headphones, headset and shower speaker
specs.charging_sources: Wall charger, power adapter, laptop/PC USB, power bank, car charger

record.description: A replacement USB charging cable with a 2.0mm x 12.0mm DC tip and a 30cm length, sold as a single unit. It is designed for Mini S530 Bluetooth earbuds and similar devices, and can draw power from many USB sources. The listing notes it is not compatible with B&O Earset 2 or Blue Parrot headsets.

specs.decoration: Felt dog animal appliqué on front

record.description: A 13-inch cube storage bin from 3 Sprouts, made of 100% polyester, designed for kids and toddlers. It fits most cube shelving units and has a front pull tab for easy removal. The front features a felt dog appliqué.

specs.insulation: Keeps food warm or cold; holds ice cubes

record.description: A grey, 15-liter insulated lunch bag with a double-deck design that keeps foods separated. Its thickened, seamless PEVA liner resists leaks and wipes clean easily. The insulated lining helps keep food warm or cold, and ice cubes can be added. Measures about 11 x 10.5 x 8 inches and weighs 1.5 pounds.

A set of four multicolor stoneware rice bowls from Denby, made in England. The bowls are listed as safe for the oven, microwave, freezer and dishwasher, and are described as handcrafted by skilled artisans.

specs.catnip: Patent-pending infusion between each corrugate layer
specs.use: Scratching block, floor scratcher, and lounging spot

record.description: The SmartyKat Super Scratcher Chaise is a corrugated cardboard cat scratcher that doubles as a lounge. Catnip is infused between each layer of corrugate, so its scent is released as your cat scratches. The shape works as a floor scratcher for crouching and scratching, and it offers a cradle-style spot for lounging. Made in the USA.

A sleeveless midi dress in navy lace with a fit-and-flare silhouette, cut to a contemporary fit that runs small, so consider sizing up if between sizes. Partially lined. This size M corresponds to US 6-8.

A cherry blossom-scented bath and shower gel from L'Occitane, sold in an 8.4 fl oz bottle. It cleanses the skin and leaves a light floral fragrance. Apply to wet skin, lather, and rinse. Listed as suitable for sensitive skin.

specs.package_dimensions: 3.12 in L x 3.12 in W x 5.06 in H

record.description: The WIX 57502XP is an automotive oil filter from the WIX brand, model number 57502XP, made in China. The package measures about 3.12 by 3.12 by 5.06 inches and weighs 0.75 pounds.

specs.features: Sand-resistant, water-resistant, quick drying
specs.included: 4 incorporated pockets, 4 ground stakes, storage bag

record.description: A large outdoor blanket measuring about 82.7 by 78.7 inches, sized for four to eight adults. Made of 100% nylon, it resists sand and water and dries quickly. It has four built-in pockets, four ground stakes for wind, and a storage bag. It folds compactly and weighs 12 ounces.

A navy and grey lace-up boat shoe from Sperry Top-Sider, sized Big Kid 5. It has a leather-like upper, a memory foam footbed for cushioning, and a rubber cupsole outsole for traction. The 360° lacing system is designed to help the fit stay snug.

specs.style: Classic Short Rubber Logo Fashion Boot
specs.logo: UGG logo rubber print on front shaft

record.description: A black women's short fashion boot in size 8 M US from UGG. It has a soft suede upper, a 17 mm UGGpure lining and insole, and a Treadlite by UGG outsole. A UGG logo is printed in rubber on the front of the shaft.

specs.size: 12 inch neck width, 22 inches bottom width, 29 inches height
specs.straps: Adjustable pink poly-webbing neck and waist straps
specs.ties: Long waist ties for tying behind the back

record.description: A pink waterproof apron made from glossy, smooth vinyl that wipes clean easily. It weighs very little, so it suits long shifts. Adjustable pink poly-webbing neck and waist straps, plus long waist ties that fasten behind the back. Measures 12 inches at the neck, 22 inches along the bottom, and 29 inches tall.

specs.product_type: Full motion TV wall mount bracket
specs.extension: Up to 14 inches from wall, collapses to 2 inches

record.description: A full motion wall mount for flat and curved TVs and monitors from 13 to 30 inches, holding up to 33 lbs. It fits 75x75mm and 100x100mm VESA patterns and offers tilt, swivel, and rotation. The arm extends up to 14 inches from the wall and collapses to 2 inches. Hardware and instructions are included.

A three-tier, fan-shaped corner shelf in distressed brown, made from lightweight paulownia wood with jute rope for hanging. Each shelf holds up to 10 lbs and mounts from a nail, screw, or hook. Designed only for corners, it can be leveled by adjusting the rope. Decorations are not included.
A baby girl's clothing set from Hudson in a 12-18 month size, featuring a blueberry pattern. The set includes coordinating dresses made from 100% cotton, intended for everyday wear.

specs.absorption: Rapid-drying top layer with Wet-Lock gel

record.description: A 50-count pack of Four Paws Wee-Wee odor control pads with Febreze Freshness scent, sized 22 by 23 inches for dogs of all sizes. The pads feature a rapid-drying top layer and a gel layer meant to trap liquid, plus a built-in attractant intended to encourage dogs to use the pad during potty training.

A two-pack of white wall-mounted folding drying racks with a heavy-duty ABS plastic mount and a 1/4-inch stainless steel rod. Each rack holds up to 60 lbs and offers 12 inches of hanging space. Mounting hardware for drywall, masonry, and wood walls is included, along with a template.

specs.lettering: Black OVERSIZE LOAD, 2 in x 12 in letters

record.description: An 18-by-84-inch yellow nylon mesh banner reading OVERSIZE LOAD in black 2-inch letters, for marking wide or oversize loads. It has heavy brass grommets for attachment to the front or back of a vehicle and black edge binding. The product is intended for hauling equipment, boats, and modular homes, and the listing states that it complies with DOT specifications.

A set of 48 neon green floating golf practice balls from A99, built with two-piece construction, 432 dimples, and an injection-molded Surlyn cover with 90 compression. Each ball floats, making them suited to pond, pool, and water range practice. A carry bag is included.

specs.connection: Universal faucet adapter and Quick Connect

record.description: This white SPT countertop dishwasher is Energy Star certified and fits six place settings in a compact footprint. It offers six wash cycles, a delay start of up to eight hours, and an LED display. A universal faucet adapter with Quick Connect helps it attach to most kitchen faucets.

specs.product type: DIY cake pop baking toy kit
specs.included: bain-marie, decorating stands, baking and decorating gadgets

record.description: A DIY cake pop baking toy kit for children ages 6 and up. The set includes a bain-marie, decorating stands, and other baking and decorating tools, plus a color-printed recipes booklet. Food ingredients are not included. The listing says baking takes about 30 seconds and requires no oven.

specs.type: Swivel sink faucet aerator / sprayer head attachment
specs.fit: Most round faucets (listing claims over 99% of home kitchen faucets)
specs.features: Anti-splash, air-infused foamy stream

record.description: A swivel faucet aerator from Srmsvyd that attaches to round faucets and rotates a full 720 degrees to direct the water flow. It offers three flow modes, from soft to strong, and is made of solid brass with a polished, electroplated finish. The listing describes it as tool-free to install and designed to produce an air-infused, less splashing stream.

specs.midsole: Bounce with Boost in the heel

record.description: Men's adidas golf shoe in grey, green and black, US size 10. Features a regular fit, lace closure, and a mesh and synthetic upper. The midsole uses Bounce cushioning with Boost in the heel. The upper contains a minimum of 50% recycled content, made with Primegreen materials.
A men's natural-colored straw hat from Stetson in size XL, model OSCLNA-3832. It has an outback-style brim and a vented crown. The listing identifies the material as straw.

A two-piece set of clear plastic apothecary jars, one 15 oz and one 20 oz, for storing cotton swabs, cotton balls, cotton rounds, makeup sponges, and bath salts. Each has a removable acrylic lid and a wide mouth. Made of acrylic plastic that looks like glass but is shatter-resistant. Includes chalkboard label stickers.

specs.included_items: 1 hybrid case, 1 tempered glass screen protector
specs.features: Shockproof, card holder slot, swivel belt clip
specs.shipping: Ships from USA, about 3-5 business days

record.description: A rose gold protective case for the Samsung Galaxy On5 with a brushed metal texture and a two-layer design. It includes a card slot, a kickstand, and a swivel belt clip, plus a tempered glass screen protector. The phone is not included.

A portable electric facial hair remover from Keenove (model Ke-208) for women, designed for use on the face, including the lips, cheeks, and chin. It uses a dual stainless steel blade system and a 180 professional motor, and it comes with one replacement head. The body is made of PTEE material.

record.color: Black or orange (double-layer, different color on each face)

specs.tree straps: 9.8 ft (3 m) webbing, 18 loops each, 1000 lbs breaking strength
specs.packing: Integrated stuff bag that attaches to hammock

record.description: A double-layer camping hammock in black or orange, one face each, sewn from seamless 210T nylon. It measures about 8.9 by 4.6 feet and is rated for up to 880 pounds. Included are two 9.8-foot webbing tree straps with 18 loops each and two carabiner clips. The hammock packs into an attached bag and is certified by TUV.

A hooded reindeer costume for dogs, sized Medium from Midlee. It fits a 10-inch neck, 14-inch chest, and 12-inch back length according to the bullet points, though the description lists different measurements (12, 16, and 14 inches), so check the sizing before ordering. Secures with Velcro at the neck and chest. Suited to Christmas or other winter-themed parties.

A 47 by 30 inch wooden desktop on a metal frame, rated for up to 165 lbs. It raises and lowers from 29 to 49 inches using dual motors, and the top tilts from 13 to 45 degrees. A touch panel offers presets, a child lock, and two USB ports.

A 10-piece pirate play set from Wild Republic, including five pirate figures, a two-piece cannon, an open treasure chest, an eye patch, and an X-marks-the-spot flag. The figures measure about 1 to 2.5 inches and are suited to ages 3 and up. Made without phthalates or lead, and can be cleaned with soap and water.

specs.cushioning: Gel pads in heel and forefoot

record.description: Blue Sof Sole performance insoles for men's shoes, sized 9 to 10.5 and trimmable to fit. They feature a contoured neutral arch and gel cushioning in the heel and forefoot, with a lightweight build meant to fit casual and athletic footwear. A moisture-wicking treatment is included to help keep feet dry.

A mid-century modern accent armchair in azure from Modway, upholstered in polyester with subtle piped trim. Its curved back and gentle recline sit on dark walnut-stained legs with non-marking caps. Dense foam padding gives a soft, supportive seat for living rooms, bedrooms, offices, or entryways.

A round, two-tier stainless steel lunch container in white with a twist-open lid and locking clips that hold the tiers together. The listing describes it as BPA free, dishwasher safe, and freezer safe, with a vacuum-tight seal intended to reduce leaks and spills. It is suited to carrying soup and other hot food.

specs.item: Women's printed knit Bermuda pajama sleep short
specs.print: Hand-drawn print by HUE NYC studio design team

record.description: A women's printed knit Bermuda pajama sleep short in chambray blue, size Large, from HUE. It features an elastic comfort waistband, a relaxed fit, and a 10.5-inch inseam. The print is hand-drawn by the HUE NYC studio design team.

specs.included accessories: 2 pairs of hands, optional head, optional backpack, holographic wings, 2 weapons

record.description: A 6-inch scale, fully articulated Falcon action figure from Bandai's S.H.Figuarts line, based on Marvel's Avengers: Infinity War. It includes interchangeable hands, an optional head, a backpack for the wings, holographic wings, and two weapons. Recommended for ages 15 and up.

A red radiator grille decal sticker sized for the 2018 Kia Stinger, sold as a one-set pack. It is a new, Korean-made 3D-printed piece meant to be applied to the front radiator grille using the included adhesive double-sided tape.

A stylized vinyl collectible figure of Thor from Marvel's Avengers: Endgame, made by Funko as part of its Pop! line. The figure stands about 3.75 inches tall and is part of a series of Avengers: Endgame Pop! figures. Note that the eye paint differences between figures are intentionally subtle.

specs.theme: My Hero Academia / Boku No Hero Academia
specs.size: XX-Large (US standard, adult and kids fit)

record.description: Joyfunny training sweatpants in the My Hero Academia style, featuring Izuku, Froppy (Tsuyu Asui) and Ochaco Uraraka themes. Made from 100% cotton, the long pants are offered in XX-Large, US standard sizing. Listed for daily wear, Halloween, themed parties and cosplay. Brand new.

specs.canopy diameter: 9 ft (48 in shade diameter per listing)
specs.pole: 1.5 in diameter steel or aluminum (listing conflicts)

record.description: A 9-foot round patio market umbrella in beige, with a 100% polyester canopy described as waterproof and fade resistant. It has eight steel ribs on a powder-coated frame, opens by crank, and tilts with a push button. A wind vent is included. The base is sold separately. The listing gives conflicting pole materials, so verify before purchase.

A children's flower-growing kit from Miracle-Gro that includes a tin planter to decorate with a six-color paint strip and brush. It contains Zinnia, Marigold, and Cosmo seed packets, two coconut fiber growing pucks, a plant liner, stake holders for labeling plant spots, and step-by-step instructions.

Men's hiking shoe in walnut, size 10.5 M US, from Merrell's Moab 2 Vent line. The upper combines performance suede leather with mesh, and the bellows tongue uses closed-cell foam to help keep moisture and debris out. It features a protective rubber toe cap, a breathable mesh lining, 5mm lug depth, and a Vibram TC5+ outsole.

specs.handle: Retractable telescoping trolley handle, extends 41 inches
specs.interior: Tear-resistant full lining with zippered organization pockets
specs.grab_handles: Top, bottom, and side flexible grab handles

record.description: A navy 20-inch carry-on suitcase from Ben Sherman with a hardside ABS shell and four multi-directional spinner wheels. It has a retractable telescoping trolley handle that extends to 41 inches, plus top, bottom, and side grab handles. The fully lined interior includes zippered organization pockets and a garment restraint panel.

specs.fit: Plus Size option available; check size chart
specs.sleeve: Long sleeve or 3/4 sleeve (varies by style)
specs.care: Hand wash cold; do not bleach; hang or line dry

record.description: A lightweight, draped open-front blazer from Doublju in red, size Small. Its soft rayon-blend fabric offers some stretch. Sleeves vary by style, long or 3/4 length. Hand wash cold, do not bleach, and hang or line dry. Suited to casual, office, and dressier occasions.

specs.age_range: 3-7 years (listing says 5 and up in places)

record.description: A 120-piece building set for children that connects plastic sticks to colored balls to make forts, tents, and towers. Pieces twist together and come with a storage bag. A blanket is needed for enclosed forts and is not included. The listing gives conflicting age ranges.

specs.material: Memory foam with silica gel and quartz nano heating elements

record.description: Rechargeable heated memory foam insoles for men and women, sized S, M, and L. They offer three adjustable temperature settings and a power display, run on a 2400 mAh battery at 7.4V, and are listed with a battery life of 3 to 6 hours. Each pair is cut to a size zone, with a one-year warranty.

specs.included: Soft white microfiber pouch with black drawstring

record.description: Jessica Simpson J5596 women's aviator sunglasses with a metal frame in gold tone and tortoise tips. The lenses are polycarbonate with a UV-protective coating and are shown in gradient brown tint. Dimensions include a 60 mm lens width, 140 mm temple length, and 18 mm bridge width. A soft white microfiber pouch with a black drawstring is included.

specs.care: Machine washable
specs.use: Football, soccer, running, yoga, all-weather sports

record.description: Defender men's tight-fitting compression pants, made from a polyester and spandex blend (92% and 8%). Designed for sports and all-weather activity, they offer a snug, second-skin fit and sun protection rated UPF 30. The listing describes them as machine washable. Sizing is given by waist and length, and the maker suggests sizing up for a looser fit.

A men's black car coat in a heavyweight wool blend, size Small. It has a button-front closure and a roomy fit through the chest and waist. The listing describes the twill fabric as thick, warm, and soft. It is sold under the Amazon Essentials brand.

A set of 12 large traditional gift bows in silver metallic foil, each about 4.5 inches across. The bows have a self-adhesive backing for quick application to gift wrap or packages. They are sold separately from the matching ribbon and banding products mentioned in the listing.

specs.type: Bluetooth FM transmitter and car audio adapter
specs.charging: Dual USB: QC 3.0 port and 2.4A port

record.description: A compact Bluetooth FM transmitter and car audio adapter in orange. It plays music from Bluetooth devices, a USB drive, or a TF card, and includes a hands-free microphone for calls. Two USB ports provide one QC 3.0 fast-charge port and one 2.4A port. It has a backlit LED display with seven colors and a 1.6-inch body with four buttons.

specs.design: Inverted bottle with internal jelly stirrer
specs.compatibility: Fits most standard 32 oz. jelly jars

record.description: The Perky-Pet 253 is a red wild bird feeder designed to hold oriole jelly. It has a 32 oz. capacity and uses an inverted bottle design, with an internal stirrer that dispenses jelly. The bottle can be swapped with most standard 32 oz. jelly jars, and the feeder is described as easy to clean.

specs.care: Machine wash warm on gentle, non-chlorine bleach, tumble dry low

record.description: Sferra's Grande Hotel king sheet set comes in white with grey stitching. The set includes a flat sheet, a fitted sheet, and two pillowcases. The sheets are 200 thread count, made in Italy from 100% Italian Egyptian cotton percale. The flat and pillowcases feature double rows of satin stitching; the fitted sheet does not.

Ten white 42mm festoon LED bulbs for automotive interior lighting such as dome, map, trunk, and cargo lights. Each bulb has 16 SMD 3528 LEDs at 6000K, rated for 50,000 hours. Plug-and-play installation, with a note that rotating a non-lighting bulb 180 degrees reverses its polarity.

A gray boat seat from Millennium Marine, model SW-200. It measures 18 inches long, 21 inches wide, and 6 inches high, and weighs 8 pounds. The seat is rated for up to 400 pounds and is designed to mount to most boat pedestals. The manufacturer offers a 3-year warranty.

specs.formula: Ammonia free, paraben free, gluten free, vegan

record.description: A ready-to-use, semi-permanent cream hair dye in a deep, cool fuschia, described as the darkest pink shade in the line. No developer is needed. The formula is ammonia-, paraben-, gluten-, and phthalate-free, vegan, and PETA-accredited. Color is expected to fade over about four to six weeks.

A women's mid-ankle boot from Timberland's White Ledge line, in dark brown leather and size 5 M US. It has a rubber lug outsole for traction and is listed as waterproof, with shock-absorbing cushioning and a rugged outdoor style.

specs.fit: UA Classic Fit with pre-curved visor

record.description: A men's Under Armour cap in Academy Blue and red, sized X-Large/XX-Large. It has a classic fit with a pre-curved visor, structured front panels, and foam padding. The fabric uses Microthread technology and HeatGear, and the brand's Freedom program supports first responders, military, law enforcement, and veterans.
A red Daewoo countertop microwave with a 0.7 cubic foot capacity, model KOR07R3ZER. It includes a turntable for even heating. Suitable for reheating and cooking in a compact kitchen.

specs.intended_use: Weddings, festivals, photography, bridal, bridesmaids, flower girls

record.description: A royal blue flower crown headband by Love Sweety, handmade and about 19 cm (7.48 inches) in diameter, which the maker says fits most heads. Suited to weddings, festivals, photo shoots, and bridal or bridesmaid looks. The listing does not specify the materials used.

specs.features: Cup holder, headphone hook, cable management tray
specs.stability: Built-in metal frame, anti-slip feet with suction cup

record.description: A black gaming desk measuring 42.5 by 23.6 by 27.56 inches, with a curved Z-shaped carbon fiber surface and a 280-pound weight capacity. It includes a cup holder, a headphone hook, a cable management tray on the back, and two speaker or CD holders. The built-in metal frame and suction-cup feet are intended to keep it steady.

A 1-inch gold-finished curling iron from Hot Tools, model HT1181XL, with a barrel described as two inches longer than standard. It offers a rotating cool tip, a rheostat temperature control reaching up to 430 degrees, and comes with a heat-resistant mat to protect countertops.

specs.care: Machine washable
specs.features: Seamless reinforcement in high-abrasion areas, grip injection technology

record.description: The Mad Grip F50 Thunderdome impact glove comes in a large size and high-visibility orange. It has a breathable knit body, seamless reinforcement in high-abrasion areas, and grip injection technology on the palm. The glove is machine washable. It is listed under sports and fitness.

specs.suspension: Front telescopic forks, rear mono shock
specs.tires: Outdoor rubber tires, longer wearing and higher grip

record.description: A blue 50cc two-stroke, air-cooled kids' dirt bike from MotoTec, sized for young riders. It has an easy pull start, a fully automatic twist throttle with a restrictable setting for speed control, front telescopic forks, a rear mono shock, and disc brakes. The frame is Chromoly steel, and the bike carries EPA and CE approval.

specs.included items: 1x battery case, 1x user manual (cable not included)

record.description: A black portable battery case for the iPhone 6, 6s, 7 and 8 (4.7-inch) with a 6000 mAh lithium-polymer battery. It supports sync-through charging, so the phone can connect to a computer while the case stays on. A charging cable is not included. Power is turned on and off manually, and wireless charging is not supported.

specs.cutouts: Large cutouts for buttons, ports, and camera

record.description: A rose gold glitter phone case designed for the Apple iPhone XR (6.1 inch). It features a three-layer build with a polycarbonate hard outer shell and a clear TPU inner layer, offering full front and back coverage, raised edges around the screen and camera, and large cutouts for buttons, ports, and the camera.

specs.extras: Detachable leather wrist strap, foldable kickstand

record.description: A purple faux-leather folio case for the Samsung Galaxy S20 (6.2-inch). It has a flip cover with a magnetic closure, nine card slots, a zipper coin pocket, and two side pockets. A detachable wrist strap is included, and a fold line on the back converts the case into a kickstand. The inner base is soft TPU.

specs.securing: Tuck under water tubes or reinforced tie-down loops
specs.use: Leaf net cover for swimming pools

record.description: A black knitted polyethylene net sized for a 16 by 32 foot rectangular pool. Placed over a winter cover before leaves fall, it catches debris so it does not settle on the cover or into the water. It can be secured by tucking it under water tubes or using the reinforced tie-down loops.

specs.suitable_floors: Hardwood, parquet, laminate, linoleum, tile, carpet

record.description: A set of five blue polyurethane replacement casters for office chairs, with a 7/16 inch standard stem and ABEC9 bearings. The listing describes a patented caster system and says the wheels are suited to hardwood, parquet, laminate, linoleum, tile, and carpet. It also states the wheels roll quietly over cables and make chair mats unnecessary.

specs.included: Generic MFi certified charger and cable

record.description: Refurbished Apple iPhone 8 (US Version) with 64GB storage in Space Gray. This unit is locked to AT&T and will not work with other carriers, so check compatibility first. Battery health was tested, with a guaranteed minimum capacity of 80%. Includes a generic MFi-certified charger and cable. Headphones and a SIM card are not included.

specs.size: One size fits most teens and adults

record.description: A white costume bonnet from Forum Novelties with an oversized, floppy brim. It is designed as one size that fits most teens and adults, and it is sold as women's headwear. The bonnet is also offered in red and black.

specs.accessories: Walking foot, non-stick foot, 5 size 16 needles, clearance plate

record.description: This gray SINGER sewing machine has a metal frame, 32 built-in stitches, and an automatic one-step buttonhole. A built-in needle threader makes threading easier, and it sews up to 1,100 stitches per minute.
